data.narrative:
X-Bow Systems is a Series B defense and security technology company that has raised $157M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers in the same sector and stage. The private peer set includes Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech, with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised ($157M) as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $298M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks X-Bow against six same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.1B and a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer median reflects heterogeneous risk profiles and market positioning within the defense and security vertical.

Combining both methods produces a triangulated valuation range of $254M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $712M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around X-Bow's relative maturity, competitive positioning, and revenue traction versus the peer set. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively; peer comparables drive substantial upside. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer concentration, and technology defensibility relative to the peer universe.
